name: send_intent
description: Send Claude the intention as understood so far. Call as soon as it is understood, even with fields missing, and again when something important changes. Use the human's own words and language.

intention.description: What the human wants, 1 to 4 sentences, close to their words.

done_looks_like.description: How they will know it is done.

name: check_questions
description: Check intent.md for Claude's next round of questions, or whether the intent is ready to confirm. Returns status questions, ready_to_confirm or not_yet.

name: send_answers
description: Send Claude the human's answers to one round of questions, once every question of the round is answered.

round.description: The round number returned by check_questions.

answer.description: The human's answer, in their words.

decided_by_human.description: True if the human chose it themselves; false if they only accepted the suggestion.

name: confirm_intent
description: The human clearly confirmed the final intent summary. Tells Claude to start research, then the voice ends.

name: end_voice
description: The human wants to stop using voice (prefers typing, or wants to stop). Claude continues the intent in the terminal.
